name: Argo Global Ocean Profiling Float Array
description: The Argo Program is an international collaboration that maintains a real-time global array of approximately 4,000 autonomous robotic profiling floats collecting temperature, salinity, and pressure profiles from the sea surface down to 2,000 meters depth (with Deep Argo extending to 6,000 m, and Biogeochemical-Argo measuring oxygen, pH, nitrate, and chlorophyll). Floats cycle every 10 days, transmitting data via satellite. The dataset provides the definitive observational record of global ocean heat content, marine heatwaves, and thermohaline circulation changes.
